Affiliate Disclosure: This post may contain affiliate links. We earn a commission when you make a purchase—at no extra cost to you. This helps support the site. Getting AdSense approval can feel like a mystery. Here’s what actually works for new blogs.
1. Publish 10-15 Quality Posts First AdSense wants to see real content. Aim for at least 10-15 posts before applying. Each post should be 500+ words with genuine value.
2. Add Required Pages About — Who you are, what your site covers Privacy Policy — Required by AdSense; mention cookies and data Contact — Email or contact form 3. Enable HTTPS Your site must use HTTPS. GitHub Pages offers free SSL—enable “Enforce HTTPS” in your Pages settings.
4. Original Content Only No copied content. AI-generated posts are fine if they’re unique and valuable. Add your own insights and edits.
5. Consistent Publishing Show you’re active. Publish regularly—our automated workflow helps with daily posts.
6. Avoid Policy Violations No adult content, violence, or prohibited content No “get rich quick” promises No copyright violations 7. Wait and Reapply First application rejected? Improve your site, add more content, and reapply in 1-2 weeks.
